newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady at 556 ct/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady at 556 ct/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator was steady at 556 cents a kg clean at the sale in Melbourne on Monday, Wool International (WI) said in its market report.
Of the 15,324 bales offered, 6.3 percent was passed in.

Japanese and Chinese buyers were principal with support from Taiwanese and Western European operators. Merinos were mixed, with 19 and 25 micron up to one percent cheaper, 20 micron was one percent dearer and 21 micron was half a percent dearer.
Skirtings were slightly dearer. Crossbreds of 27/28 microns were unchanged and 26 micron was 1.5 percent cheaper.
WI said sales continue on Tuesday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 41,000 bales to be offered.
